transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been hearing voices that other people can't hear, and it's really starting to scare me. I also just feel so incredibly sad, depressed, and empty inside lately.
Have you experienced these voices only during times when you were feeling severely depressed, or have you also heard them during periods when your mood was relatively stable or normal?

I've heard them during both times, actually. There was a period of about two or three weeks where my mood felt relatively normal, but I was still hearing the voices just as clearly. It seems like they don't always go away even when I'm not feeling depressed.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were [Schizoaffective Disorder (Depressive Type), Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features]. The patient's report that the psychotic symptoms persist for at least two weeks in the absence of mood symptoms strongly favors Schizoaffective Disorder over Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features, as the latter requires psychotic symptoms to occur exclusively during a major depressive episode.
